column1: # E1 — retrieval benchmark.
# One question per line: the question, a tab, then the page names that would be
# a correct answer, comma-separated. Questions are written the way a person
# actually asks them, not in the vocabulary of the page — the whole point is to
# measure the gap between the two.
# A question with more than one acceptable page has more than one because a
# person asking it would be equally well served by any of them, not because the
# ranker happened to return them.
# Lines starting with # are comments. Blank lines are ignored.
